# Cross-Entry Dependency & Ownership Requirements Checklist: Profile

**Purpose**: Validate that entry R4's boundaries with entries R1, R2 and R3 — what it inherits, what it authors, what it merely observes — are stated unambiguously enough to build and review against
**Created**: 2026-08-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Graded against**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), [research.md](../research.md) and [contracts/](../contracts/), and against the sibling specs this entry's boundaries reference.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are requirements specified for whether this entry may edit files another entry owns? [Gap, contracts/profile-screen.md *The route*, contracts/ux-conventions.md *App-wide singletons*]
- [x] CHK002 Is the obligation to mount the two shell singletons stated as a requirement on this entry, on the shell entry, or on neither? [Clarity, Spec §FR-033, §FR-034]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for adding a second reset action to the authentication feature's existing module? [Gap, contracts/change-password-link.md *The action*]
- [x] CHK004 Is the banner region the connection banner renders into a stated obligation of the shell entry that this entry may rely on? [Assumption, contracts/ux-conventions.md]
- [x] CHK005 Are the screen header's inputs specified precisely enough to be built against before the shell exists? [Assumption, contracts/profile-screen.md *The route*]
- [x] CHK006 Are requirements stated for what this entry does if an upstream entry delivers a differently shaped version of something it depends on? [Gap, Spec §Dependencies]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK007 Does this spec's split of the four cross-cutting conventions agree with the claims the shell entry's and the roster entry's specs make about the same four? [Conflict, Spec §FR-031-034, §Clarifications, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK008 Is the display-name module's location settled, or does it remain conditional on which entry is built first — the same kind of build-order conditional the clarification removed for the four conventions? [Conflict, contracts/profile-screen.md *What renders* vs Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK009 Do the requirements consistently state that this entry adds no dependency on the roster entry? [Consistency, Spec §FR-031-034, §Dependencies, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK010 Is the "no shared write path to extract" argument stated consistently in both entries whose write paths it compares? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, contracts/ux-conventions.md]
- [x] CHK011 Are the requirements this entry inherits and the requirements it establishes distinguished consistently, so that a cited requirement id is never mistaken for an owned one? [Consistency, Spec §Requirements preamble, checklists/requirements.md *Requirements coverage*]

## Requirement Clarity & Measurability

- [x] CHK012 Can "wherever a display name renders" be evaluated at this point in the roadmap, given how few surfaces exist to observe? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004, §SC-009]
- [x] CHK013 Is "the same rate limit as the forgotten-password request" specified by a reference a reviewer can follow to concrete numbers? [Traceability, Spec §FR-028, §SC-011]
- [x] CHK014 Is "the screen that does enforce the policy" identified unambiguously enough to serve as an acceptance condition? [Measurability, Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK015 Are the properties this entry observes end to end distinguishable from those it must implement, item by item? [Clarity, Spec §Inherited constraints, contracts/change-password-link.md]
- [x] CHK016 Is "no entry owns them" operationally meaningful for the two singletons, or does it leave delivery unassigned? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-033, §FR-034]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK017 Are requirements stated for which acceptance scenarios can be evaluated before the shell entry lands? [Gap, Spec §Dependencies, plan.md *Technical Context*]
- [x] CHK018 Are requirements defined for the case where the route exists but the entry point that links to it does not yet? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK019 Are the downstream consequences of a rename on surfaces that do not yet exist stated as this entry's obligation or as an explicitly named non-obligation? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK020 Are requirements defined for how this screen behaves if a shell singleton it raises messages into is absent? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-033, §FR-034]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK021 Is every upstream dependency named together with the entry that owns it? [Completeness, Spec §Dependencies]
- [x] CHK022 Is the claim of no downstream reach-back stated in a form later entries can actually be held to? [Measurability, Spec §Dependencies]
- [x] CHK023 Are the three assumptions the design carries forward each traceable to a spec statement that records the same silence? [Traceability, research.md *Assumptions carried forward*, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK024 Are the four complexity entries the plan records each traceable to a requirement that forces them, rather than to a design preference? [Traceability, plan.md *Complexity Tracking*]
- [x] CHK025 Is the adoption of an unstable API of an already-approved dependency covered by a requirement, or is it a design choice with no requirement behind it? [Traceability, plan.md *Complexity Tracking*, Spec §FR-033]
- [x] CHK026 Is the ownership of the request-origin convention attributed to an entry anywhere in the requirement set? [Gap, contracts/update-own-profile.md, contracts/change-password-link.md]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK027 Are the two declined extractions recorded as decisions this spec makes, or as decisions the plan makes on the spec's behalf? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, plan.md *Complexity Tracking*]
- [x] CHK028 Is the statement that both build orders satisfy the requirements as written still accurate after the clarification that removed the build-order conditional? [Consistency, checklists/requirements.md *Notes*, Spec §Clarifications]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items are numbered sequentially within this file; each domain checklist numbers independently
